details.title: What’s New
details.lead: Bob Haggart, 1939, words by Johnny Burke. The chorus as it is written, both endings in their place, in C major: concert C4 to F5. Each A begins on a long C and slides down in triplets and eighths to a low E♭; the middle part is the same line a fourth higher, from F. Slow, about 72 a minute.
